Owen and Lily are preparing a report about the pedestrian street. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The campus pledged to reach net zero by 2035.

Lily thanked Owen for the honest advice. People around Lily often share different ideas about the pedestrian street. Lily is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. Listen with headphones for the full sound.
The pedestrian street looked quieter than usual that evening. Little by little, things began to change. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, a photo of the bill is proof of purchase.

Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The bus terminal has become an important part of daily life. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The humorless guard did not smile once at our jokes.
Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Lily ordered rice and coffee at the bus terminal last night. At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit.
